IDQ20860
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Initial Minor Flood Warning for the Barcoo River

Issued at 11:33 am AEST on Tuesday 20 October 2026
Flood Warning Number: 1


MINOR FLOODING ESTIMATED TO BE OCCURRING AT BLACKALL

Rainfall during the last few days across the upper reaches of the Barcoo River catchment
has resulted in river level rises along the Barcoo River at Blackall. Minor flooding is
estimated to be occurring at Blackall.

Barcoo River to Isisford:
Minor flooding is estimated to be occurring at Blackall

No observations are currently available for the Barcoo River at Blackall. Based on the
nearby automatic gauge the river level is estimated to be around the minor flood level and
rising. The Barcoo River at Blackall may peak above the minor flood level (2.00 m) from
Tuesday into Wednesday.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 12:00 PM AEST on Wednesday 21 October 2026.
